verdict.rationale: Antigravity documents MCP support that lets the agent fetch structured context from and act on external remote APIs. MCP servers can be configured via slash commands, bundled into plugins, and layered in the SDK. Google Drive links also appear as external documents in the sidebar. However, no first-party Jira or Slack connectors are evidenced, so connecting those tools depends on the user sourcing and configuring generic MCP servers. Missing for 10: named first-party Jira/Slack integrations, documented Google Drive connector setup beyond links appearing as documents, independent hands-on corroboration of workflow-tool connections.
